CONTROL: at z = z_D this IS BorromeanMarkovTrace.lean's closed form
MASS lands within 0.05 % of the derived cap

the mass channel is >100x less sensitive to z than decay (so quote its agreement WITH this leverage)

description: The Borromean Markov trace re-derived with the Ocneanu parameter z SYMBOLIC, removing the circularity in the committed closed form (which has convention D substituted and carries no z). Controls exactly against BorromeanMarkovTrace.lean at z = z_D. Then measures z from the mass channel at the CONVENTION-FREE muon pin: it lands 0.0203 % from the derived cap while the decay channel misses by 63 %, localising the Q_beta anomaly to the decay channel rather than to the convention. Corrects PR #6144's joint-determinacy framing: the weights are a ONE-parameter family, so the system is over-determined, not jointly determined.

data.residual_not_absorbed: tr_M residual 2.42e-7 relative is ~21x the mu-p substrate tension (11.5 ppb), so it is not obviously that tension and not obviously experimental. Stated as a residual, not absorbed.
data.why_muon_pin: the proton pin is fixed THROUGH F_Bor and therefore presupposes the convention under test; the muon pin is m_mu/m_e = Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2, pure geometry, no trace. E1/E2 carve-out of the 2026-08-30 directive.
